name: spotlight
title: Spotlight
description: The soft, angled glow that fades in behind hero copy: one rotated ellipse under a 151-unit Gaussian blur, absolutely positioned and sized as a percentage of its container. `fill` defaults to `currentColor`, so a text-colour class on the parent tints it.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/spotlight

Installed to `components/ui/aceternity/spotlight.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/aceternity/spotlight';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/spotlight

Requires the `@interlace/theme` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency).
